reason: The README clearly describes a DSH plugin that automates Git change analysis, commit creation, and code review through /commit and /review commands, with /commit capable of modifying the repository.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 添加 /commit 和 /review 命令，用于分析 Git 变更、创建规范提交并生成代码审查报告。
summaries.en: Adds /commit and /review commands to the DSH web GUI for analyzing Git changes, creating conventional commits, and generating code review reports.

capabilities: Registers /commit and /review slash commands in the DSH web GUI
Runs git status, diff, log, and related repository inspection commands
Stages selected changes and creates git commits through the model workflow
Reviews staged and unstaged changes without modifying files
Uses DSH subprocess, sandbox, and approval mechanisms
